method: a constant is found the same way a global is: for every reference site, the twin of the window matches on its literal bytes, and the twin's bytes where the source carried the value are the counterpart. This catches the cases where cross-title movement is not an address: a structure grew between the titles, so the fixtures that allocate or copy it must use the title's own size.
